decisions.statement: The pages system service runs on a workstation.
The pages system service answers for the pages in akasha and for no page outside akasha.
A query is answered from the index and from the values beside the pages that query names.
A read takes no lock.
A read is answered while another read is being answered.
An answer is never older than the file that answer speaks for.
A write commits the values its pages keep in the commit.
A value a page keeps outside the commit is written beside the page and committed with nothing.
A write is not gated by the checks.
A write is not a break of the glass.
Writes arriving while a write is committing are committed together.
A write names its writer.
The writer a write names stands in the commit.
A write that did not commit put nothing into the commit.
The index the pages system service reads is built from the commit at HEAD.
The index names the paths the pages system service does not answer for.
A pod reaches the pages system service over the tailnet.
The port the pages system service listens on is read from this page.
The host names the pages system service answers on are read from this page.
The pages system service answers on the house network.
A page stating no port is refused when the page is written.
The store the cluster reaches reads as ready only while the pages system service is listening.
No caller of the pages system service is asked for a credential.
An answer costs nothing where the pages the answer rests on have not changed.
The pages system service is started again for as long as that service is failing.

definition: the service answering page queries and landing page writes
